statement: Ancient Maya calendrical systems integrated mathematical counting with repeated observations of solar, lunar, and planetary cycles; the Haab, Tzolk’in, Calendar Round, and Long Count supported chronological recording of historical and mythic dates.

sources.citation: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian, Living Maya Time, “Calendar” and “The Calendar System.”
sources.author: Smithsonian NMAI
sources.venue: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian

sources.citation: John H. Linden, “Glyph X of the Maya Lunar Series: An Eighteen-Month Lunar Synodic Calendar,” American Antiquity (2017).
sources.author: John H. Linden

notes: The panel describes documented calendrical/astronomical expertise, not a modern scientific worldview.
